charts.title: Total dietary supplements market size worldwide from 2016 to 2028 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Total global dietary supplements market size 2016-2028
charts.description: This statistic shows the estimated and projected size of the total global dietary supplements market from 2016 to 2028. By 2028, the dietary supplements market is projected to generate around 308 billion U.S. dollars worldwide.
charts.note: Worldwide; as of June 2021

charts.title: Total U.S. dietary supplements market size in 2022, 2023, and 2031 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Total U.S. dietary supplements market size 2023 vs. 2031
charts.description: By 2031, the value of the U.S. dietary supplement market is expected to reach exceed 70 billion U.S. dollars. This would be a significant increase compared to 2022 when the market was valued at around 43 billion U.S. dollars.
charts.note: United States; as of February 2024; * Estimated.  ** Projected. Read more

charts.title: Total U.S. dietary supplements market size from 2016 to 2024, by ingredient (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Total U.S. dietary supplements market size by ingredient 2016-2024
charts.description: This statistic shows the estimated and projected size of the total dietary supplements market in the United States from 2016 to 2024, by ingredient. By 2024, the dietary supplements market is projected to generate around 57 billion U.S. dollars, of which around 23 billion will be generated by vitamins.
charts.note: United States; as of February 2018

charts.title: Value of the vitamin and supplement (VMS) market in the United States in 2018, by category (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Value of the U.S. vitamin and supplement market 2018, by category
charts.description: This statistic shows the value of the vitamin and supplement market in the United States in 2018, by category. In that period, mineral supplement sales generated 3.74 billion U.S. dollars in the United States. The total U.S. vitamins market was valued at 7.42 billion U.S. dollars.
charts.note: United States; 52 weeks ended November 7, 2018; * For total U.S. multi-outlet (supermarkets, drug stores, mass market retailers, military commissaries and select club and dollar retail chains) for the 52 weeks ended November 7, 2018. Read more
charts.source: IRI; Winsight Grocery Business Market value in billion U.S. dollars

charts.title: Unit sales of the vitamin and supplement (VMS) market in the United States in 2018, by category (in millions)
charts.short: Unit sales of the U.S. vitamin and supplement market 2018, by category
charts.description: This statistic shows the unit sales of the vitamin and supplement market in the United States in 2018, by category. In that period, the multivitamins segment had unit sales of about 183.3 million in the United States.
charts.note: United States; 52 weeks ended November 7, 2018; * For total U.S. multi-outlet (supermarkets, drug stores, mass market retailers, military commissaries and select club and dollar retail chains) for the 52 weeks ended November 7, 2018. Read more

charts.title: Most popular types of dietary supplements among U.S. adults in 2020
charts.short: Dietary supplement usage among U.S. adults by type 2020
charts.description: This statistic depicts the most popular types of dietary supplements among U.S. adults. The statistic is based on a survey conducted in August 2020. Almost all adult supplement users surveyed took vitamins and minerals. The nutritional supplement industry has seen a large growth in the market, especially in protein supplements and vitamins.
charts.note: United States; August 27 to 31, 2020; 1,471 respondents; 18 years and older; supplement users

charts.title: Perrigo Company's revenue from 2018 to 2023, by segment (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Revenue of Perrigo by segment 2018-2023
charts.description: This statistic displays the revenue of the Perrigo Company by segment from 2018 to 2023. In 2023, Perrigo generated a total revenue of roughly 4.7 billion U.S. dollars, of which nearly three billion were generated from the Consumer self-care Americas (CSCA) segment. Perrigo Company plc is a manufacturer of pharmaceutical over-the-counter (OTC) products. The company has one of its headquarters in Grand Rapids, Michigan.
charts.note: Worldwide; * During 2021, Perrigo sold its generics business. Previous years have not been restated. Read more

charts.title: General Nutrition Corporation's (GNC) revenue from 2017 to 2019, by segment* (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Revenue of GNC by segment 2017-2019
charts.description: This statistic displays the revenue of GNC (General Nutrition Corporation) by segment in 2017, 2018, and 2019. In 2017, GNC generated 2.02 billion U.S. dollars from its U.S. and Canada operations. General Nutrition Corporation is focused on the retail of health and nutrition products, especially vitamins, minerals, and other supplements. The company is headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.
charts.note: Worldwide; * Discontinued due to company bankruptcy and purchase by Chinese Harbin Pharmaceutical Group during 2020. Read more

charts.title: Glanbia's revenue from 2016 to 2021, by segment (in million euros)
charts.short: Revenue of Glanbia by segment 2016-2021
charts.description: This statistic displays the global revenue of Glanbia from 2016 to 2021, by segment. In 2021, Glanbia generated some 1.3 billion euros of revenue through its Global Performance Nutrition segment. Glanbia plc is a manufacturer of sports nutrition, dairy products, vitamins, minerals, and other supplements. The company is headquartered in Kilkenny, Ireland.
charts.note: Worldwide

charts.title: Abbott Laboratories' segment revenues from 2017 to 2023 (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Abbott's segment revenues 2017-2023
charts.description: Abbot Laboratories is an international medtech and pharmaceutical company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. In 2013, Abbott Laboratories was split into two companies: Abbot (medical products) and AbbVie (research-based pharmaceuticals). As of 2023, the medical devices segment was the largest segment within the company and generated 16.9 billion U.S. dollars in revenues. Abbot’s diagnostics segment was, prior to 2023, the largest generator of revenue but dropped to around ten [...]
charts.note: Worldwide

charts.title: Usage of dietary supplements among U.S. adults from 2008 to 2023
charts.short: Dietary supplement usage in U.S. adults 2008-2023
charts.description: This statistic indicates the percentage of surveyed U.S. adults that take dietary supplements from 2008 to 2023. The survey is conducted annually during summer. In 2021, a record-high 80 percent of the adult population in the United States took dietary supplements, according to the survey. The nutritional supplement industry has seen a large growth in the market, especially in protein supplements and vitamins.
charts.note: United States; 2008 to 2023; around 3,200; 18 years and older

charts.title: Usage of dietary supplements among U.S. adults in 2020, by age group
charts.short: Dietary supplement usage in U.S. adults by age 2020
charts.description: This statistic indicates the percentage of surveyed U.S. adults that take dietary supplements in 2018, distributed by age group. The survey was conducted in August 2018. In the age group of the 18-34 year-olds, 69 percent of respondents reported taking dietary supplements. Over two-thirds of the adults population in the United States takes dietary supplements, according to the survey. The nutritional supplement industry has seen a large growth in the market, especially in protein [...]
charts.note: United States; August 27 to 31, 2020; 2,006 respondents; 18 years and older

charts.title: Usage of dietary supplements among U.S. adults in 2020, by gender
charts.short: Dietary supplement usage in U.S. adults by gender 2020
charts.description: This statistic indicates the percentage of U.S. adults that take dietary supplements, distributed by gender. The statistic is based on a survey conducted in August 2020. Among U.S. adult males, some 68 percent reported taking dietary supplements. Almost two-thirds of the adult population in the United States takes dietary supplements. The nutritional supplement industry has seen a large growth in the market, especially in protein supplements and vitamins.
charts.note: United States; August 27 to 31, 2020; 2,006 respondents; 18 years and older

charts.title: Usage of dietary supplements among U.S. adults in 2020, by education level
charts.short: Dietary supplement usage in U.S. adults by education 2020
charts.description: This statistic indicates the percentage of U.S. adults that take dietary supplements, distributed by education level. The statistic is based on a survey conducted in August 2020. Some 75 percent of the respondents with a college degree reported taking dietary supplements. Almost two-thirds of the adult population in the United States takes dietary supplements. The nutritional supplement industry has seen a large growth in the market, especially in protein supplements and vitamins.
charts.note: United States; August 27 to 31, 2020; 2,006 respondents; 18 years and older

charts.title: Usage of dietary supplements among U.S. adults in 2019, by region
charts.short: Dietary supplement usage in U.S. adults by region 2019
charts.description: This statistic indicates the percentage of surveyed U.S. adults that take dietary supplements, distributed by region. The statistic is based on a survey conducted in August 2019. In the Midwest, 74 percent of respondents reported taking dietary supplements. Around two-thirds of the adults population in the United States takes dietary supplements. The nutritional supplement industry has seen a large growth in the market, especially in protein supplements and vitamins.
charts.note: United States; August 22 to 26, 2019; 2,006 respondents; 18 years and older

charts.title: Healthy habits of users and non-users of dietary supplements among U.S. adults in 2023
charts.short: Dietary supplement usage in U.S. adults by healthy habits 2023
charts.description: This statistic indicates the healthy habits of users and non-users of dietary supplements among U.S. adults. This statistic is based on a survey conducted in August 2023. According to the survey, 58 percent of those who did not take supplements exercised regularly, while the percentage stood at 72 percent among supplement-users. The nutritional supplement industry has seen a large growth in the market, especially in protein supplements and vitamins.
charts.note: United States; August 9–14, 2023; 3,192 respondents; 18 years and older
categories: Try to eat a balanced diet

charts.title: Dietary supplements with largest increase in usage due to COVID-19 among U.S. adults as of August 2020
charts.short: Top dietary supplement usage growth due to COVID in U.S. adults 2020
charts.description: Among U.S. adult users of dietary supplements who changed their regimen during the COVID-19 pandemic, almost 60 percent stated thay they increased their multivitamin supplement routine. This statistic is based on a survey conducted in August 2020. In general, around two-thirds of the adult population in the United States takes dietary supplements.
charts.note: United States; July 31 to August 4, 2020; 554 supplement users; 18 years and older

This statistic is based on a survey conducted in August 2020. In general, around two-thirds of the adult population in the United States takes dietary supplements.

charts.title: Employment contribution of the U.S. dietary supplement industry as of 2016
charts.short: Employment contribution U.S. dietary supplement industry 2016
charts.description: This statistic shows the employment contributed by the dietary supplement industry in the United States as of 2016. The dietary supplement industry generates nearly 400 thousand direct jobs, and more than 750 thousand when indirect and induced employment is included.
charts.note: United States

charts.title: Estimated number of jobs as a direct economic impact of the U.S. dietary supplement industry in 2016
charts.short: Direct impact of the dietary supplement industry on the U.S. job market in 2016
charts.description: This statistic displays the number of jobs generated as a direct result of the dietary supplement industry in the United States in 2016. According to the data, 185,639 jobs in direct sales were existent due to the U.S. dietary supplement industry in 2016.
charts.note: United States

charts.title: Estimated number of jobs as an indirect economic impact of the U.S. dietary supplement industry in 2016
charts.short: Indirect impact of the dietary supplement industry on the U.S. job market in 2016
charts.description: This statistic displays the number of jobs which were an indirect result of the dietary supplement industry in the United States in 2016. According to the data, nearly 57,000 jobs in the business and personal services sector were indirectly generated by the U.S. dietary supplement industry.
charts.note: United States
charts.source: CRN; John Dunham and Associates Number of jobs

charts.title: Types of cannabis-infused products consumers are interested in purchasing in the United States as of 2019, by generation
charts.short: Consumer interest in cannabis-infused product purchase U.S. 2019, by generation
charts.description: Millennials were the most interested in cannabis-infused products among all generations of Americans as of 2019. Health and personal care products were of most interest. On a scale of 1 to 5 with five representing "very interested" the average score given by the Millennial 1 (18-27 years of age) cohort for relaxation products was 2.84.
